picks.rationale: Suno opening a developer API turns the leading AI-music generator into a platform — directly actionable for anyone building music/creative tools.
picks.excerpt: Suno's Chief Product Officer announced the company is exploring a developer API for its AI music generation platform, inviting developers to apply for early access through a curated partnership program.

picks.rationale: Freshest item (07-06) in the defining AI-music copyright fight; the 61k-recordings scope decision will shape licensing for every generative audio tool.
picks.excerpt: Suno has filed to block Universal Music Group and Sony's attempt to add over 61,000 recordings to their copyright infringement lawsuit, citing a similar denial in the parallel Udio case.

picks.rationale: Free chiptune synth shipped because AI coding tools unblocked a years-stalled project — a concrete, usable example of AI-assisted tool-making.
picks.excerpt: Chiptune act YMCK released Magical FDS Plug, a free FDS sound chip synthesizer whose developer leveraged AI coding tools to overcome technical complexity that had stalled the project for years.

picks.rationale: Browser-based generative sequencing you can try immediately — a designed, non-prompt alternative to AI generation that balances the section's coverage.
picks.excerpt: Smol Sequencer is a browser-based modular sequencing environment with algorithmic/generative capabilities, where users patch interconnected patterns through the UI rather than relying on AI systems.
